sources.minimum_moic: 2.0x over a 5-year hold, consistent with the IRR hurdle.
sources.require_base_case_covenant_compliance: No maintenance covenant breach permitted in the base case.

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.description: Management-style base case: low/mid single-digit growth as the iPhone 6 cycle normalises; offshore cash remains trapped.

scenarios.name: Bull
scenarios.description: Sustained iPhone upgrade demand plus Services growth; a one-time repatriation tax lets the sponsor use offshore cash at close; exit at a re-rated multiple.

sources.repatriation_tax_rate: One-time 14% transition tax on accumulated foreign earnings, as proposed in the US FY2016 budget (approx.). VERIFY.

scenarios.name: Bear
scenarios.description: iPhone units peak in FY2015: revenue declines and gross margin compresses on mix and FX; exit multiple de-rates to a hardware-cycle valuation.
